title: A pointwise flat complete-intersection fibre admits a standard affine model
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], let $x\in X$ and $s=f(x)$, and let $V=\operatorname{Spec}R\subseteq S$ be any affine open neighbourhood of $s$. Assume that $f$ is of finite presentation at $x$ [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], that the local homomorphism $\mathcal O_{S,s}\to\mathcal O_{X,x}$ is flat [def-weil-flat-morphism], and that the local ring $\mathcal O_{X_s,x}$ of the scheme-theoretic fibre [def-pc-scheme-fibre] is a complete-intersection local ring over $\kappa(s)$ in the local-ring sense specified in [lem-trf-lci-pointwise-criterion]. Then there are an affine open neighbourhood $U=\operatorname{Spec}B\subseteq X$ of $x$ with $f(U)\subseteq V$, integers $n,c\geq0$, and polynomials $h_1,\ldots,h_c\in R[t_1,\ldots,t_n]$ such that the ring map induced by $f|_U:U\to V$ identifies $B$ with $R[t_1,\ldots,t_n]/(h_1,\ldots,h_c)$ as an $R$-algebra, and this presentation is a relative global complete intersection [def-weil-pbc-relative-global-complete-intersection]. In particular its nonzero fibre rings have Krull dimension $n-c$, as required by that definition.
